answer: Anchor each agent identity to one DMV-verified vehicle registration, checked quarterly against the registry; a plate may anchor only one identity, and transferring it revokes the old one. A sybil farmer cannot wander through cheap digital copies: every fake identity needs a real registered vehicle, about $3,000 per car plus annual fees, so 1,000 fakes cost over $3 million before any profit. Like a comet that leaves one visible trail, each registration creates an auditable inlet into the economy that auditors can trace, revoke, and blacklist if abused.
